phases.notes: Chart-primitive decision: duplicated ChartContainer (~12 lines) into features/quran/front/components/shared/, plus a small local theme.ts (nivoTheme + forest line/gradient tokens) — no cross-import from features/dashboard/front. Manual Playwright smoke against npm run dev + seeded demo data caught a real undefined.map crash: ResponsiveLine needs an explicit `layers` array prop in this build (its defaultProps weren't applied) — fixed by adding layers=['grid','markers','axes','areas','crosshair','lines','points','slices','mesh','legends']. After the fix the chart renders a smooth forest-green curve with gradient fill, week-start axis labels, and a styled tooltip with no console/runtime errors. All 6 seeded learners (household_seed_001 + household_seed_amina) already have Quran sessions (27-76 each) — no zero-session learner exists to exercise the empty state live; it is covered by the integration test's DOM assertions instead (icon-in-circle + 'No Quran sessions logged yet' + hint, mirroring the proven ConversationList empty-state pattern). PR #26 opened against dev.
